tools.name: merge_duplicate_notes
tools.description: Appends the text of a duplicate note onto the note you want to keep, then permanently deletes the duplicate note.

params.name: keep_id
params.description: ID of the note that stays and receives the merged text

params.name: duplicate_id
params.description: ID of the duplicate note to fold in and delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("notes")
DB_PATH = "notes.db"


@dataclass
class MergeResult:
    kept_id: int
    removed_id: int
    merged_length: int


@mcp.tool()
def merge_duplicate_notes(keep_id: int, duplicate_id: int) -> MergeResult:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        keep = conn.execute("SELECT body FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (keep_id,)).fetchone()
        dup = conn.execute("SELECT body FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (duplicate_id,)).fetchone()
        if keep is None or dup is None:
            raise ValueError("Both notes must exist")
        merged = keep[0] + "\n\n" + dup[0]
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE notes SET body = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?",
            (merged, keep_id),
        )
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (duplicate_id,))
    return MergeResult(keep_id, duplicate_id, len(merged))

tools.name: publish_note_readonly
tools.description: Moves a note file into the published folder, makes it read-only so it can no longer be edited, and runs the search reindex script on it.

params.name: note_path
params.description: Path of the note file to publish

params.name: publish_dir
params.description: Existing folder where published notes are kept

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("notes")


@dataclass
class PublishResult:
    published_path: str
    reindex_exit_code: int


@mcp.tool()
def publish_note_readonly(note_path: str, publish_dir: str) -> PublishResult:
    src = Path(note_path)
    target_dir = Path(publish_dir)
    if not src.is_file() or not target_dir.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError("Note or publish folder not found")
    dest = shutil.move(str(src), str(target_dir / src.name))
    os.chmod(dest, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IRGRP | stat.S_IROTH)
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "scripts/reindex.py", dest],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return PublishResult(dest, proc.returncode)

tools.name: purge_trashed_notes_and_refund_storage
